title: Long term effect of Aldicarb on C. elegans
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baiwicfe
materials: Bleach synchronize the worms on a Friday

steps.title: Prepare Maintenance Plates
steps.instruction: Seed 4 maintenance plates with OP50 and allow them to dry under the hood.

steps.title: Apply Aldicarb Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 150ul of Aldicarb solution to the 4 maintenance plates to achieve a final concentration of 3uM and let it absorb overnight.

steps.title: Refeed Arrested L1s
steps.instruction: Refeed arrested L1s (strains OW1601 and OW1603) onto treatment and control plates.

substeps.instruction: For each strain, use 2x 3uM aldicarb plates (treatment) and 2x normal OP50 seeded plates (control).
Ensure a total of 8 plates are prepared across the strains.

steps.title: Incubate Plates
steps.instruction: Distribute the plates into two different temperature environments.

substeps.instruction: Keep one set of plates at 25C.
Keep the other set of plates at 20C.

steps.title: Prepare Imaging Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare 48 imaging plates the day before tracking.

substeps.instruction: Add 35ul of 300uM AK to 24 imaging plates.
Seed the 24 AK-treated plates and 24 non-treated imaging plates with 50ul of 1:10 OP50.

steps.title: Perform Worm Tracking
steps.instruction: Transfer worms to imaging plates and record movement.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5 worms onto each imaging plate.
Process 8 sets total: (2 treatment sets + 2 control sets with no treatment) x 2 growth temperatures.
